2609.31395.title: ActKV: Efficient LLM Agents through Action-Guided KV Cache Management
2609.31395.paper_summary: Agentic LLM inference accumulates long KV caches across iterative observation-reasoning-action loops, imposing substantial memory overhead and limiting serving throughput. Existing compression methods emphasize overall output quality, overlooking the asymmetric importance of actions in driving task progress. Our key idea is to establish a compression criterion that values KV entries by their contribution to action generation and prioritizes action quality. However, iterative execution, dynamic memory demands, and scattered action-critical entries pose challenges to eviction policies, budget allocation, and paged memory integration. To this end, we propose ActKV, the first KV cache compression framework tailored for agentic LLM inference. (i) Action-oriented KV cache eviction exploits stable action access patterns to retain entries critical to future actions, supporting reliable task progress under compression. (ii) Confidence-driven adaptive budget allocation uses LLM's intrinsic confidence to adapt the budget to evolving action-critical memory demands. (iii) Page-aware compression management standardizes compression into three primitives with customized kernels, realizing practical throughput gains. On long-trace tasks, ActKV retains an average of 98.53% of FullKV's accuracy with only 25.98% of its peak KV cache memory. It also achieves 3.97 times and 3.58 times FullKV's token and task throughput, delivering state-of-the-art performance.
2609.31395.paper_summary_zh: 代理 LLM 推理在迭代的觀察-推理-行動循環中累積長期 KV 快取，造成相當大的記憶體開銷並限制服務吞吐量。現有的壓縮方法強調整體輸出品質，卻忽視了行動在推動任務進展中的不對稱重要性。我們的關鍵想法是建立一個壓縮標準，根據 KV 條目對行動生成的貢獻來評價，並優先考慮行動品質。然而，迭代執行、動態記憶體需求以及分散的行動關鍵條目對驅逐政策、預算分配和分頁記憶體整合提出了挑戰。為此，我們提出了 ActKV，首個專為代理 LLM 推理量身打造的 KV 快取壓縮框架。(i) 以行動為導向的 KV 快取驅逐利用穩定的行動訪問模式來保留對未來行動至關重要的條目，支持在壓縮下的可靠任務進展。(ii) 基於信心的自適應預算分配利用 LLM 的內在信心來調整預算，以應對不斷變化的行動關鍵記憶體需求。(iii) 頁面感知壓縮管理將壓縮標準化為三個原語，並配備自定義內核，實現實際的吞吐量增益。在長追蹤任務中，ActKV 在僅使用 25.98% 的峰值 KV 快取記憶體的情況下，保留了平均 98.53% 的 FullKV 準確性。它還實現了 FullKV 的 3.97 倍和 3.58 倍的標記和任務吞吐量，提供了最先進的性能。
